description: This file defines the PayGrade class, which extends FilterField and implements ValueXNormalizable. It is part of the OrangeHRM reporting system, specifically handling filtering related to employee pay grade information. The class provides methods for adding SQL query conditions, returning entity aliases, and converting the value to an array representation including pay grade details.

classes.name: PayGrade
classes.description: A filter class for handling pay grade filtering in reports. It constructs query conditions and converts pay grade data into array format for report generation.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds a WHERE condition to the query builder if the operator is EQUAL and the filter value is not null.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the entity alias used in the query, in this case 'salary'.

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Converts the filter value (pay grade ID) into a label and ID array if the pay grade exists.
